quote: We introduce VOICECRAFT, a Transformer-based neural codec language model (NCLM) that performs infilling generation of neural speech codec tokens autoregressively conditioned on bidirectional context. VOICECRAFT achieves state-of-the-art (SotA) performance on both speech editing and zero-shot TTS.
We introduce VOICECRAFT, a Transformer-based neural codec language model (NCLM) that performs infilling generation of neural speech codec tokens autoregressively conditioned on bidirectional context.

For our subjective evaluation, we used the Amazon Mechanical Turk platform to conduct human listening tests... For speech editing, the outputs of our model on all 310 utterances from REALEDIT are evaluated by Turkers in terms of naturalness and intelligibility... For speech editing, the outputs of our model on all 310 utterances from REALEDIT are evaluated by Turkers in terms of naturalness and intelligibility, using a 5‑point Likert scale where 1 means poor and 5 means excellent. We also performed side‑by‑side A/B testing of VOICECRAFT's output against the original (non‑edited) speech, as well as the edited speech produced by FluentSpeech. In both cases, Turkers were asked to determine which utterance sounds more natural.
